title: 2 tier bamboo steamers
text: 2 tier bamboo steamers. This is a nice set.  Not sure if I will ever make my own dumplings or won tons - (comes with a plastic press and stuffing spreader) - but - the set also comes with cotton steamer liners - washable - reusable - I was excited about that.  They seem pretty sturdy - time will tell.  The 2 tier steamer baskets I received didn't really fit together - the marry was just a little off - they note they are handmade - but wish they fit together nicely.  They say they are constructed of bamboo and appear to be.  I did order another set that is made out of spruce. It will be nice to compare quality and use.  We'll see if the fit improves with use - maybe? or could be worse with the swelling in water.  Just not sure.  Having said that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Annie’s Kitchen Complete Set Handmade Bamboo Steamer Baskets, Lid Dumpling Maker with Spoon, 4 Reusable Cotton Liners, 2 sets Chopsticks- For Rice, Vegetables, Fish, Meat, Desserts (8 Inch- 2 Tiers)
features: Experience the difference. It's not just another kitchen gadget. Works great with wok or stainless steamer pot. Once you prepare a meal with our 2” depth steamer baskets, you'll wonder how you ever lived without one. Annie's Kitchen bamboo steamer allows you to preserve the flavor, texture, minerals, and nutrients of your food. It's more than just a dumpling steamer kit or bun steamer. Prepare Asian inspired dishes and enjoy perfectly moist and delicious fish, vegetables, rice, meats, and more.

Everything you need for authentic dining - We include 2-tiered 8” steamer baskets with lid, 4 reusable and washable cotton liners, 2 sets of durable bamboo chopsticks, and a dumpling maker with spoon that’s made from wheat straw. Try the art of steaming long practiced by Chinese cooks and discover an ancient and ingenious way to make foods quickly with the perfect crispness and flavor.

Quick, easy, and delicious - Spend less time in the kitchen preparing and cleaning up meals. Use one layer as a veggie steamer basket and one layer for meats or seafood. Our hand woven baskets have an open weave design, allowing more steam to pass through and foods to steam quickly. Place the food on top of the liner, stack baskets, then place baskets on top of an inch or more of boiling water. You're done, just sit and let the magic happen.

You are what you eat - Layer fresh herbs, spices, or aromatics between meats and vegetables. Steam over broth instead of water for enhanced flavor. Our steamer basket set provides you with infinite possibilities for creating mouthwatering foods with top nutritional value. Enjoy dim sum, tender juicy chicken breasts, or crispy veggies. Our interlocking steamer baskets allow you to make a full course meal in no time.

Annie's Kitchen means quality you can trust - We insist on the very best for our customers. 100% hand woven baskets that are naturally BPA free and made of ethically sourced bamboo. All-natural, reusable and washable cotton liners. We never use glue or chemicals and every part of our kit is biodegradable. Quality materials ensure durability and longevity.
